verdict.rationale: Snowflake provides strong audit-log evidence via Query History (who ran what queries) and the ACCESS_HISTORY view, which explicitly tracks read/write operations for compliance auditing and highlights popular/frequently accessed tables and columns. However, the evidence pack does not document a full column-level lineage graph feature (e.g., a lineage/dependency explorer showing upstream-to-downstream column provenance), only column-level access tracking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated data lineage/graph feature, independent corroboration of lineage accuracy in practice.
